
cdrom/cd-seek-far
The head's path through a seek to near the disc's end: per cell (speed, from, to, SeekL or SeekP) the control seek's time and
the polled SeekL's (command write -> INT2, M cycles), then time(M):sector-less-target where GetlocP's sector changed (| marks
the INT2). FAR is 40 s short of GetTD's lead-out. No assertions.
